call.title: Licence audit — acme-orders
call.content:
Licence audit — acme-orders
5 packages: 2 allowed, 2 copyleft, 1 unknown

## Summary
- Python (requirements.txt, 5 packages); allow-list MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC; read with `pip-licenses --format=json`.

## Copyleft
- psycopg2 2.9.9 — LGPL — direct — triggers on static linking; the wheel links dynamically; replacing it means pg8000 (BSD).
- readline-gpl 1.2 — GPL-3.0 — direct — triggers on distribution; find a replacement or confirm the project is never distributed.

## Unknown
- internal-metrics 0.4 — licence field UNKNOWN; the package is the company's own; add a LICENSE to its repository.

## Allowed
| Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fastapi | 0.141.0 | MIT |
| httpx | 0.28.1 | BSD |

## Not read
- none

script.say:
5 packages: 2 allowed, 2 copyleft (psycopg2 LGPL, readline-gpl GPL), 1 unknown.

## Report
- ran 2 commands; wrote "Licence audit — acme-orders"
